issue_context.title: Add API to make configuring the HostOptions easier
comments:
This is a follow up request to add a second overload:

```c#
namespace Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting
{
    public static class HostingHostBuilderExtensions
    {
+        public static IHostBuilder ConfigureHostOptions(this IHostBuilder hostBuilder, Action<HostBuilderContext, HostOptions> configure);
        public static IHostBuilder ConfigureHostOptions(this IHostBuilder hostBuilder, Action<HostOptions> configure);
    }
}
```


**Reason 1:**

There is precedence on `HostingHostBuilderExtensions.ConfigureLogging` with the following two overloads:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/689c4927f3e51a8a688a707066c21e5b47d17419/src/libraries/Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting/ref/Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting.cs#L42-L43

(also with HostingHostBuilderExtensions.UseDefaultServiceProvider):
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/eceb5c8951ca3e5902a6eecdd594f82916ff4762/src/libraries/Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting/ref/Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting.cs#L50-L51

**Reason 2:**
Both two new `ConfigureHostOptions` APIs proposed end up calling into `ConfigureServices`:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/8a31e66a86ec2e8be53d0b0798ced68b9f410be3/src/libraries/Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting/ref/Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting.cs#L34

which could take a delegate with `HostBuilderContext`

---

This discussion is currently blocking PR https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/49502#discussion_r596466330
I hope this doesn't need to go to API review again 🤩
